### PR_MCQ_M1: Areolar loose connective tissue matrix contains which structural combination?

- A) Chondrocytes and ossein
- B) Fibroblasts, mast cells, collagen, elastic fibers
- C) Myocytes
- D) Neuroglia

> **✅ Answer:** B) Fibroblasts, mast cells, collagen, elastic fibers
> **Explanation:** Areolar CT contains fibroblasts, mast cells, and fibers.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Areolar loose connective tissue matrix c" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M2: White fat adipocytes differ from brown fat because white fat cells are:

- A) Multilocular
- B) Monolocular for energy storage
- C) Rich in thermogenin
- D) Non-vascular

> **✅ Answer:** B) Monolocular for energy storage
> **Explanation:** White fat is monolocular energy storage.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="White fat adipocytes differ from brown f" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M3: Fibrocartilaginous intervertebral spinal discs function as:

- A) Lubricants
- B) Mechanical shock absorbers
- C) Red marrow sites
- D) Blood filters

> **✅ Answer:** B) Mechanical shock absorbers
> **Explanation:** Fibrocartilage absorbs compression in spinal discs.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Fibrocartilaginous intervertebral spinal" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M4: Calcium ions released during muscle stimulation bind directly to subunit:

- A) Myosin
- B) Troponin C
- C) Actin
- D) Tropomyosin

> **✅ Answer:** B) Troponin C
> **Explanation:** Ca2+ binds Troponin C during muscle contraction.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Calcium ions released during muscle stim" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M5: Ciliated ependymal neuroglia line brain ventricles to secrete fluid:

- A) Lymph
- B) Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)
- C) Blood plasma
- D) Synovial fluid

> **✅ Answer:** B) Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)
> **Explanation:** Ependymal cells line ventricles and secrete CSF.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ciliated ependymal neuroglia line brain " style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M6: Compound stratified cuboidal epithelium lines ducts of:

- A) Skin surface
- B) Sweat glands
- C) Lung alveoli
- D) Stomach lumen

> **✅ Answer:** B) Sweat glands
> **Explanation:** Stratified cuboidal lines sweat gland ducts.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Compound stratified cuboidal epithelium " style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M7: Reticular Type III collagen connective tissue frames internal matrix of:

- A) Tendons
- B) Lymphoid organs (Spleen, lymph nodes)
- C) Bones
- D) Arteries

> **✅ Answer:** B) Lymphoid organs (Spleen, lymph nodes)
> **Explanation:** Reticular CT forms scaffolding of spleen and lymph nodes.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Reticular Type III collagen connective t" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M8: Which plasma protein maintains capillary blood colloid osmotic pressure?

- A) Fibrinogen
- B) Serum Albumin
- C) Globulin
- D) Prothrombin

> **✅ Answer:** B) Serum Albumin
> **Explanation:** Albumin maintains capillary colloid osmotic pressure.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which plasma protein maintains capillary" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PR_MCQ_M9: Fast-twitch white muscle fibers generate rapid contraction energy via:

- A) Aerobic respiration
- B) Anaerobic glycogen glycolysis
- C) Beta-oxidation
- D) Myoglobin storage

> **✅ Answer:** B) Anaerobic glycogen glycolysis
> **Explanation:** White muscle relies on anaerobic glycogen glycolysis.

### PR_MCQ_M10: Unipolar sensory neurones featuring 1 axon and NO dendrites occur during:

- A) Adult brain stage
- B) Embryonic developmental stage
- C) Cardiac muscle
- D) Spinal ventral horn

> **✅ Answer:** B) Embryonic developmental stage
> **Explanation:** Unipolar neurones occur in embryonic nervous system.
